response.sql: SELECT translink, ordertypedist, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY ordertypedist) AS fraction FROM (SELECT a.translink AS translink, t.ordertypedist AS ordertypedist, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord t ON t.transreg = a.translink WHERE a.peercorr > 0.149 AND t.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.translink, t.ordertypedist) ORDER BY fraction DESC, translink, ordertypedist LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Each matched (advancedbehavior, transactionrecord) pair counts as one record, so the count is the number of joined rows per translink and order type mix. The denominator is the sum of those counts across all translinks for the same order type mix, after the peercorr filter and after dropping rows with a missing order type mix.
Ties in the fraction are broken by translink, then ordertypedist, because the request does not say how to order them.
